svg.title: Pop-up Campaign: Salah Fokus Narrative (Wrong Focus Centered)
svg.desc: Seven-zone journey where the explicit core is recognizing and correcting "wrong focus" in both life struggles and hair care
svg.text: Dove Campaign: "Salah Fokus" (Wrong Focus)
You're solving the wrong problem in both your life and your hair.
SALAH FOKUS: Fighting symptoms, ignoring causes
Entry: "You're Fighting Something"
Immersive audio + suspended strands
Recognition phase: Visitors recognize their own struggle
Key message: "You're exhausted. You're trying to fix something. But is it the right thing?"
"Salah Fokus" Wall: Two-Column Life vs. Hair
Dual-column interactive wall with parallel narratives
Left column: LIFE STRUGGLE (what you're fixing)
E.g., "Stressed about college → I'm healing myself with entertainment"
Right column: HAIR STRUGGLE (what you're fixing)
E.g., "Hair falling → I'm buying expensive shampoo"
Pattern visibility phase: "See the pattern?"
Pressure Tunnel: "You're Solving the Wrong Thing"
Immersive experience showing symptoms vs. causes
Left side: What you SEE (symptoms you try to fix)
• Stress/exhaustion → Managing stress with meditation, entertainment
• Hair falling → Buying better shampoo, managing diet
Right side: What you CAN'T SEE (actual causes you ignore)
• Lack of study → Root problem of academic failure
Exit message: "You're treating the surface. But the problem is deeper."
Root Room: "Where's The Real Problem?"
Calm education space revealing the unseen causes
Cause identification phase: Make the invisible visible
Life example: "Your stress doesn't come from having bad stress-management skills.
It comes from not addressing the root cause: the work/study/life imbalance itself."
Hair parallel: "Your hair doesn't fall because you have bad hair-care skills.
It falls because your SCALP BARRIER is compromised. That's the root."
Diagnosis: "What You've Been Missing"
Beauty advisor consultation (diagnosis moment)
Reveal phase: Show what was invisible
Advisor dialogue:
"You've been treating your hair. You've been managing stress. But you missed something.
Your SCALP is the actual problem. It's compromised, under-nourished, weak.
That's why your hair falls. Not because of stress. Not because of shampoo.
Because your scalp barrier isn't strong enough."
Treatment: "Now You Know What to Fix"
Hands-on experience with RIGHT solution
Action phase: Experience scalp-focused care
Key message: "This is what treating the REAL PROBLEM feels like.
Not managing stress. Not better shampoo.
Treating your scalp barrier. Rebuilding strength at the source."
Feel the difference: Serum, massage, cooling = scalp recovery
Integration: "Stop Fighting the Wrong Thing"
Reflective space + personal keepsake
Empowerment phase: Correct focus
Exit message: "You came here fighting stress and buying shampoo.
You're leaving knowing: treat your SCALP. That's the real solution."
Affirmation: "Stop focusing on the wrong thing. Start caring for what matters."
Salah Fokus: The Wrong Focus Pattern
Salah Fokus: You're solving the symptom, ignoring the cause in both places.
